name: redstone
normalizations: Compare settled redstone circuits set by commands: dust decaying along a line and connecting only to signal sources, dots and crosses, dust climbing and stepping down blocks, torches on blocks with and without strong power, repeaters with delays and locking, comparators comparing, subtracting and reading a cauldron, and strong power through blocks from levers.
Lamps set after their power source keep their state until a neighbour changes, as vanilla's do.
